headlines.title: Govs. Kevin Stitt and Wes Moore say civility can win general elections but primaries promote partisanship
headlines.description: Govs. Kevin Stitt, R-Okla., and Wes Moore, D-Md., on Friday blamed partisan primaries for making politics more extreme and called for bringing back “dignity” in politics and government.

headlines.title: Sen. Bernie Moreno says former son-in-law Max Miller shouldn’t serve in Congress following abuse allegations
headlines.description: Sen. Bernie Moreno, R-Ohio, said that his former son-in-law Rep. Max Miller should not serve in Congress following domestic abuse allegations made by Miller’s ex-wife and the senator’s daughter, Emily Moreno.

headlines.title: Rep. Marcy Kaptur hospitalized after hit-and-run car crash
headlines.description: Rep. Marcy Kaptur was hospitalized with non-life threatening injuries following a hit-and-run car crash Sunday morning, a spokesperson from the Toledo Police Department said.

headlines.title: Wes Moore & Kevin Stitt say civility can win general elections, but primaries are the problem
headlines.description: Gov. Wes Moore (D-Md.), Gov. Kevin Stitt (R-Okla.) and Unite CEO Tim Shriver join Kristen Welker for a Common Ground conversation on dignity in politics, live from the National Governors Association event in Oklahoma City.

headlines.title: Bernie Sanders on if he regrets Platner endorsement: ‘Easier to be a Monday morning quarterback’
headlines.description: In an exclusive interview with Meet the Press, Sen. Bernie Sanders (I-Vt.) shares his thoughts on the Maine Senate race after Sen. John Fetterman (D-Pa.) criticized Sanders for having “no regrets” over endorsing Graham Platner.

headlines.title: Govs. Jared Polis & Spencer Cox debate social media bans for teens
headlines.description: Govs. Jared Polis (D-Md.) and Spencer Cox (R-Utah) joined Kristen Welker for a Common Ground conversation on technology and the youth, live from the National Governors Association event in Oklahoma City.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: Sen. John Kennedy says he’d exclude Jan. 6 rioters from an ‘anti-weaponization’ fund bill
headlines.description: Sen. John Kennedy, R-La., told NBC News’ “Meet the Press” that he would not provide the Trump administration with a “blank check” for the proposed “anti-weaponization” fund.

headlines.title: Truth Social launches service selling faster access to Trump posts
headlines.description: Wall Street firms can now be alerted of the “most market-moving” social media posts from President Donald Trump before the general public — as long as they pay the right price.

headlines.title: Trump rebukes Jeanine Pirro over decision to drop Reflecting Pool vandalism case
headlines.description: President Donald Trump criticized longtime ally Jeanine Pirro Saturday after she agreed to drop a case against a former Olympic canoeist who was accused of vandalizing the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool.

headlines.title: Troy Jackson launches first general election ad in Maine Senate race
headlines.description: Maine’s Democratic Senate nominee Troy Jackson is launching his first general election ad, highlighting his own background as a labor organizer and going after Republican Sen.

headlines.title: Trump says he’ll revive ‘anti-weaponization’ fund if Blanche’s nomination for AG is blocked
headlines.description: Trump threatened to “push hard” to keep a $1.8 billion “anti-weaponization” fund active, amid an ongoing feud between two Republican senators and the Trump administration over Todd Blanche’s nomination for attorney general.
